Contact us

Purpose

A better life for millions of people

With our products we help to protect the health of millions of people and enable those affected to enjoy a better quality of life. "Innovating for a better life" is the motto according to which about 13,000 Gerresheimer employees on three continents develop and produce every day with a high level of industrial competence and impact.

Sustainability

Sustainability at all levels

By 2030, Gerresheimer will only procure electricity from renewable energy sources and will reduce its CO2 emissions by 50% by 2030. We set ourselves these ambitious sustainability targets because we firmly believe that only companies that act responsibly and sustainably have a future.

Excellence

Benchmark for quality

Quality comes first at Gerresheimer - as a daily philosophy and commitment to our customers. By using state-of-the-art technologies, we ensure that our products meet the highest hygiene and safety requirements and comply with the strictest legal regulations.

Global footprint

Operating globally and close to customers

Gerresheimer develops and produces in 39 local plants in Europe, America and Asia. We know our customers' needs and the markets. This ensures that we find the right solutions more quickly and can guarantee sustainable and environmentally friendly production with high added value at the individual locations.

Our product areas

Pharmaceutical primary packaging

We offer an extensive portfolio of glass and plastic packaging solutions of highest quality.
